insight.headline: Invalid Metafield Queries
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change is part of API version 2026-10. Previously, such queries would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to handle the new error response. This change affects all GraphQL Admin API queries that filter by metafields. Developers should review their code to ensure they are handling potential errors correctly. They should also test their queries with the new API version to catch any potential issues.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate results from GraphQL queries, as invalid metafield queries will now return errors instead of incorrect results.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy and reliability of the GraphQL Admin API, which is essential for building robust and trustworthy Shopify apps.
insight.code_example: query { products(filter: { metafield: { key: "my_metafield", value: "my_value" } }) { edges { node { id } } } }

updates.title: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests
updates.summary: Merchants can now see partner details on collaborator requests, enhancing trust and decision-making. This change aims to provide merchants with more context when approving collaborator requests.

updates.title: The shopify-account component for customer accounts is now a Theme Store requirement
updates.summary: The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, enabling customers to sign in and manage their accounts directly on the storefront. This component supports passwordless sign-in and automatic sign-in with other Shopify stores.

updates.title: createdAt is now available on the Customer object in Shopify Functions
updates.summary: The Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field, allowing developers to use the customer account creation date and time in Function logic. This is an additive change with no breaking effects.

updates.title: Updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes
updates.summary: Updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes, ensuring accurate tax calculations for unfulfilled orders. This change affects the orderUpdate GraphQL mutation.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.3
updates.summary: The @shopify/cli-hydrogen package has been updated to version 13.0.3, which uses the IPv4 loopback address in local debugger instructions and updates dependencies.

updates.title: @shopify/mini-oxygen@4.2.1
updates.summary: The @shopify/mini-oxygen package has been updated to version 4.2.1, improving the reliability of local debugger connections.

updates.title: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers
updates.summary: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API, enabling extensions to discover and send documents to connected receipt printers.

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, providing more accurate results and preventing silent failures.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events, enabling apps to subscribe to events for various objects and metafield changes.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, simplifying theme page building and editing.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, enabling app developers to build merchant-facing analytics without standing up their own stack.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview provides early access to new inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API, allowing developers to build and test against these APIs.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance collaborator trust, customer account management, and order tax calculations

themes.title: Trust and Security
themes.detail: Merchants can now view partner details on collaborator requests, and invalid metafield queries return errors in the GraphQL Admin API, improving the overall security and reliability of the platform. Additionally, the shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, supporting passwordless sign-in and automatic sign-in with trusted devices.

themes.title: Customer Account Management and Order Updates
themes.detail: The shopify-account component supports customer account management, and updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes. The Customer object in Shopify Functions also now includes a createdAt field, allowing for more precise customer account management.

themes.title: Development Tools and APIs
themes.detail: Hydrogen and mini-oxygen have received updates, including patch changes to improve local debugger connections and instructions. POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API.

actions.text: Update themes to include the shopify-account component
Test order updates with new tax calculation
